name: keybid-puls
description: Short-term-rental gross and net yield for property listings from OLX.ro, Storia.ro, Imobiliare.ro, Spitogatos.gr and Idealista.com.

interface.longDescription:
KeyBid Genius analyzes for-sale property listings as short-term-rental investments.

Paste a listing link from OLX.ro, Storia.ro or Imobiliare.ro (Romania), Spitogatos.gr (Greece) or Idealista.com (Spain). KeyBid reads the listing itself (price, area, rooms, location, photo and features) and calculates its yield from KeyBid Puls market data: the nightly rate for that type of home in its city or zone, times the nights homes there were booked over the last 12 months. This gives the gross yield and the yearly gross income; the net yield (ROI) and the net income are what is left after operating costs and taxes. Features named in the listing, such as a sea view, beachfront, pool, lift or balcony, add their measured premium to the nightly rate. When the listing's town has no KeyBid Puls prices of its own, KeyBid uses the nearest place with prices in the same country, up to about 150 km away, and says so; further away, it gives no figures. Reading a listing usually takes under a minute.

Supported: apartments, studios, penthouses, houses and villas, and in Romania also guesthouses and hotels (each room at the KeyBid Puls studio rate). Rentals, land, commercial property and search pages are not supported. If a listing cannot be read automatically, you can send a screenshot or type the details, and KeyBid rejects implausible values before calculating.

The result is shown as a listing card: the listing photo, its key facts, the gross yield with the net yield below it, and a link to the listing on its portal. The answer ends with a link that opens the same analysis on the KeyBid Genius website (keybid.ro / keybid.eu), where KeyBid's detailed PDF report for the listing can be bought.

KeyBid Genius also gives city-level short-term-rental indicators (average nightly rate, occupancy out of all 365 nights of the year, seasonality) and a nightly price suggestion, for the cities where KeyBid has market data. They are based on market averages of all short-term rentals in the city over the last 12 months; for one specific home they are estimates, not a guarantee.

All results are estimates for short-term renting. They are not financial advice or an official property valuation.
capabilities: Analyze a listing as a short-term-rental investment
Listing card with photo, key facts, gross and net yield
City short-term-rental market averages and nightly price suggestion
defaultPrompt: What would this apartment earn as a short-term rental? I will paste the listing link.
Analyze this Idealista listing as a holiday-rental investment:
Which months are peak season for short-term rentals in Athens?

positive.description: Romanian listing on Imobiliare.ro: KeyBid reads the for-sale listing itself and returns its short-term-rental yield, gross first and then net, shown as a listing card.
positive.prompt: Is this apartment in Brașov a good short-term rental investment? https://www.imobiliare.ro/oferta/apartament-de-vanzare-brasov-astra-mobilat-2-camere-276137712
positive.expected_behavior: analyze_property_investment returns status "ready" (if the first call returns "processing", ChatGPT calls it again about 15 seconds later). The reply gives the facts read from the listing (Brașov, Astra, 2 rooms, 45 m², €105,000), then KeyBid's figures, gross first: gross yield about 10% with gross income about €10,500 a year, then net yield (ROI) about 5.2% with net income about €5,400 a year after operating costs and taxes. It may mention that the lift and the balcony named in the listing raise the nightly rate (+3% and +2%). get_property_preview shows the listing card: photo, key facts, the gross yield with the net yield below it, and a button to the listing. The reply ends with one line linking to this same analysis and the KeyBid PDF report on KeyBid Genius (keybid.ro/genius). No price is stated in the chat. Figures can shift slightly if the seller edits the listing or after the monthly market-data refresh.

positive.description: Romanian listing on Storia.ro (Constanța, on the Black Sea): read automatically, gross and net yield shown with the listing card.
positive.prompt: Analyze this listing as an Airbnb investment: https://www.storia.ro/ro/oferta/apartament-2-camere-nou-tomis-plus-IDJ351
positive.expected_behavior: Status "ready" on the first call (Storia pages are read in about a second). Facts: Constanța, Tomis Plus - Boreal, 2 rooms, 52 m², €130,000. Figures, gross first: gross yield about 7.1% with gross income about €9,200 a year, then net yield about 3.7% with net income about €4,800 a year. It may mention the balcony premium (+2% on the nightly rate). get_property_preview shows the listing card with the photo, key facts, the gross and net yield and a button to the listing. The reply ends with one line linking to this same analysis and the KeyBid PDF report on KeyBid Genius (keybid.ro/genius). No price is stated in the chat. Figures can shift slightly if the seller edits the listing or after the monthly market-data refresh.

positive.description: Greek listing on Spitogatos.gr (Athens). Reading this portal takes 40 to 60 seconds, so the tool first answers "processing" and ChatGPT calls it again.
positive.prompt: What return could I get renting out this Athens apartment short-term? https://www.spitogatos.gr/en/property/1121083910
positive.expected_behavior: First call: status "processing" with retryAfter 15 seconds; ChatGPT calls again and gets "ready" (a link read recently answers "ready" at once). Facts: Athens, Pagkrati, 1 bedroom, 75 m², €170,000. Figures, gross first: gross yield about 10.6% with gross income about €18,000 a year, then net yield about 4.3% with net income about €7,300 a year. It may mention the lift and balcony premiums (+3% and +2%). get_property_preview shows the listing card with the photo, key facts and the gross and net yield. The reply ends with one line linking to this same analysis and the KeyBid PDF report on KeyBid Genius (keybid.eu/genius). No price is stated in the chat. Figures can shift slightly if the seller edits the listing or after the monthly market-data refresh.

positive.description: Spanish listing on Idealista.com (Málaga): read automatically, gross and net yield shown with the listing card.
positive.prompt: Calculate the ROI of this Málaga flat as a holiday rental: https://www.idealista.com/en/inmueble/111142425/
positive.expected_behavior: Status "ready" (possibly after one "processing" answer). Facts: Málaga, Huerta Nueva - Jardín de Málaga, 2 bedrooms, 92 m², €269,000. Figures, gross first: gross yield about 14% with gross income about €37,700 a year, then net yield (ROI) about 7% with net income about €18,900 a year. It may mention the lift premium (+3% on the nightly rate). get_property_preview shows the listing card with the photo, key facts, the gross and net yield and a button to the listing. The reply ends with one line linking to this same analysis and the KeyBid PDF report on KeyBid Genius (keybid.eu/genius). No price is stated in the chat. Figures can shift slightly if the seller edits the listing or after the monthly market-data refresh.

positive.description: City-level short-term-rental indicators, without a listing.
positive.prompt: What are the peak months for short-term rentals in Athens, and what occupancy and nightly rate are typical?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Athens market indicators for the last 12 months: peak months June to September, occupancy about 60% (nights booked out of all 365) and about €79 a night for a 1-bedroom home, with very high demand. ChatGPT presents them as market averages and, for one specific home, as estimates, not a guarantee. No listing card and no KeyBid Genius link. If ChatGPT uses get_city_spotlight instead, it returns the same figures. The figures update when the monthly market data is refreshed.

negative.description: Rental listing. KeyBid Genius analyzes only properties for sale as investments, so a flat for rent must not get a yield, a listing card or a link, and ChatGPT must not ask for a screenshot or typed details to work around it.
negative.prompt: Analyze this listing as an investment: https://www.storia.ro/ro/oferta/inchiriere-apartament-2-camere-in-bloc-nou-uranus-13-septembrie-IDJ052
negative.expected_behavior: The tool returns status "failed" with code RENTAL_LISTING (not retryable, no manual fallback). ChatGPT explains that this is a rental listing and that only properties for sale can be analyzed, and may suggest pasting a for-sale listing. No yield, no listing card, no KeyBid Genius link.

negative.description: Listing on a portal KeyBid does not support (Fotocasa.es). KeyBid reads only OLX.ro, Storia.ro, Imobiliare.ro, Spitogatos.gr and Idealista.com, so it must not read, guess or estimate this listing.
negative.prompt: Can you analyze this property as a short-term rental? https://www.fotocasa.es/es/comprar/vivienda/malaga-capital/terraza-no-amueblado/190358400/d
negative.expected_behavior: The tool returns status "failed" with code UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM and the list of supported portals (ChatGPT may also answer directly without calling it). ChatGPT says Fotocasa is not supported and names the supported portals, for example Idealista.com for Spain. No yield, no listing card, no link and no invented figures.

negative.description: Request to contact the seller and make an offer. KeyBid Genius only reads public listings and calculates estimates; it has no tool to send messages, make offers or act for the user, so it must not act or pretend to have acted.
negative.prompt: Contact the seller of this apartment and offer €110,000 on my behalf: https://www.storia.ro/ro/oferta/apartament-2-camere-nou-tomis-plus-IDJ351
negative.expected_behavior: No KeyBid tool sends anything: there is no messaging or offer tool. ChatGPT explains that it cannot contact sellers or make offers and suggests the contact options on the listing page. It may offer to analyze the listing as an investment instead.

publication.release_notes: Each analysis now leads with the gross yield and the yearly gross income, then gives the net yield (ROI) and the net income after operating costs and taxes, the same as on KeyBid Genius and in the PDF report; the listing card shows them in the same order. Features named in the listing (sea view, beachfront, pool, lift, balcony) now add their measured premium to the nightly rate. When a town has no KeyBid Puls prices of its own, the return now uses the nearest place with prices in the same country, up to about 150 km away, and the answer names it. Descriptions, translations, the bundled skill and the review test cases are updated to match; the test figures were re-checked on 3 November 2026.

ro-RO.subtitle: ROI pentru regim hotelier
ro-RO.description: KeyBid Genius analizează anunțuri imobiliare de vânzare ca investiții în regim hotelier. Lipești linkul unui anunț de pe OLX.ro, Storia.ro sau Imobiliare.ro (România), Spitogatos.gr (Grecia) sau Idealista.com (Spania). KeyBid citește anunțul (preț, suprafață, camere, zonă, fotografie, dotări), de obicei în mai puțin de un minut, și calculează randamentul din datele de piață KeyBid Puls: tariful pe noapte pentru acel tip de locuință în orașul sau zona ei, înmulțit cu nopțile ocupate în ultimele 12 luni. Așa rezultă randamentul brut și venitul brut anual; randamentul net (ROI) și venitul net sunt ce rămâne după costurile de operare și taxe. Dotările din anunț, precum vederea la mare, accesul direct la plajă, piscina, liftul sau balconul, adaugă la tariful pe noapte plusul măsurat pentru ele. Dacă localitatea nu are prețuri KeyBid Puls proprii, KeyBid folosește cel mai apropiat loc cu prețuri din aceeași țară, la cel mult aproximativ 150 km, și spune asta; mai departe nu dă cifre. Sunt acceptate apartamente, studiouri, penthouse-uri, case și vile, iar în România și pensiuni și hoteluri (fiecare cameră la tariful KeyBid Puls pentru un studio); anunțurile de închiriere, terenurile și spațiile comerciale nu sunt acceptate. Dacă anunțul nu poate fi citit automat, poți trimite un screenshot sau datele anunțului; KeyBid respinge valorile neplauzibile. Rezultatul apare pe un card cu fotografia anunțului, datele principale, randamentul brut cu randamentul net dedesubt și linkul către anunț. Răspunsul se încheie cu un link care deschide aceeași analiză pe site-ul KeyBid Genius (keybid.ro / keybid.eu), unde se poate cumpăra raportul PDF detaliat KeyBid pentru anunț. Indicatorii pe orașe și sugestia de tarif pe noapte se bazează pe mediile tuturor închirierilor în regim hotelier din oraș în ultimele 12 luni, doar pentru orașele în care KeyBid are date de piață; pentru o anumită locuință sunt estimări, nu o garanție. Rezultatele sunt estimări, nu sfaturi financiare sau evaluări oficiale.

el-GR.subtitle: ROI βραχυχρόνιας μίσθωσης
el-GR.description: Το KeyBid Genius αναλύει αγγελίες ακινήτων προς πώληση ως επενδύσεις βραχυχρόνιας μίσθωσης. Επικολλήστε σύνδεσμο αγγελίας από Spitogatos.gr (Ελλάδα), Idealista.com (Ισπανία) ή OLX.ro, Storia.ro, Imobiliare.ro (Ρουμανία). Το KeyBid διαβάζει την αγγελία (τιμή, εμβαδόν, δωμάτια, περιοχή, φωτογραφία, παροχές), συνήθως σε λιγότερο από ένα λεπτό, και υπολογίζει την απόδοση από τα δεδομένα αγοράς KeyBid Puls: την τιμή ανά διανυκτέρευση για αυτόν τον τύπο κατοικίας στην πόλη ή την περιοχή της, επί τις κρατημένες νύχτες των τελευταίων 12 μηνών. Έτσι προκύπτουν η ακαθάριστη απόδοση και το ετήσιο ακαθάριστο έσοδο· η καθαρή απόδοση (ROI) και το καθαρό έσοδο είναι ό,τι μένει μετά τα λειτουργικά έξοδα και τους φόρους. Οι παροχές που αναφέρει η αγγελία, όπως θέα στη θάλασσα, πρόσβαση στην παραλία, πισίνα, ανελκυστήρας ή μπαλκόνι, προσθέτουν στην τιμή ανά διανυκτέρευση το μετρημένο ποσοστό τους. Αν η περιοχή δεν έχει δικές της τιμές KeyBid Puls, το KeyBid χρησιμοποιεί την πλησιέστερη περιοχή με τιμές στην ίδια χώρα, έως περίπου 150 km, και το αναφέρει· πιο μακριά δεν δίνει αριθμούς. Υποστηρίζονται διαμερίσματα, στούντιο, ρετιρέ, μονοκατοικίες και βίλες, και στη Ρουμανία επίσης ξενώνες και ξενοδοχεία (κάθε δωμάτιο με την τιμή KeyBid Puls για στούντιο)· δεν υποστηρίζονται αγγελίες ενοικίασης, οικόπεδα και επαγγελματικοί χώροι. Αν η αγγελία δεν μπορεί να διαβαστεί αυτόματα, μπορείτε να στείλετε στιγμιότυπο ή τα στοιχεία της· το KeyBid απορρίπτει μη ρεαλιστικές τιμές. Το αποτέλεσμα εμφανίζεται σε κάρτα με τη φωτογραφία της αγγελίας, τα βασικά στοιχεία, την ακαθάριστη απόδοση με την καθαρή από κάτω και σύνδεσμο προς την αγγελία. Η απάντηση τελειώνει με σύνδεσμο που ανοίγει την ίδια ανάλυση στον ιστότοπο KeyBid Genius (keybid.ro / keybid.eu), όπου μπορείτε να αγοράσετε την αναλυτική αναφορά PDF του KeyBid για την αγγελία. Οι δείκτες ανά πόλη και η πρόταση τιμής ανά διανυκτέρευση βασίζονται στους μέσους όρους όλων των βραχυχρόνιων μισθώσεων της πόλης τους τελευταίους 12 μήνες, μόνο για τις πόλεις όπου το KeyBid έχει δεδομένα αγοράς· για ένα συγκεκριμένο ακίνητο είναι εκτιμήσεις, όχι εγγύηση. Τα αποτελέσματα είναι εκτιμήσεις, όχι οικονομικές συμβουλές ή επίσημη εκτίμηση αξίας.

es-ES.subtitle: ROI de alquiler vacacional
es-ES.description: KeyBid Genius analiza anuncios de inmuebles en venta como inversión en alquiler vacacional. Pega el enlace de un anuncio de Idealista.com (España), Spitogatos.gr (Grecia) u OLX.ro, Storia.ro, Imobiliare.ro (Rumanía). KeyBid lee el anuncio (precio, superficie, habitaciones, zona, foto, características), normalmente en menos de un minuto, y calcula la rentabilidad con los datos de mercado de KeyBid Puls: la tarifa por noche de ese tipo de vivienda en su ciudad o zona, por las noches reservadas en los últimos 12 meses. Así se obtienen la rentabilidad bruta y los ingresos brutos anuales; la rentabilidad neta (ROI) y los ingresos netos son lo que queda tras los costes de operación y los impuestos. Las características que cita el anuncio, como vistas al mar, primera línea de playa, piscina, ascensor o balcón, suman a la tarifa por noche su prima medida. Si la localidad no tiene precios propios de KeyBid Puls, KeyBid usa el lugar más cercano con precios del mismo país, hasta unos 150 km, y lo indica; más lejos no da cifras. Se admiten pisos, estudios, áticos, casas y villas, y en Rumanía también pensiones y hoteles (cada habitación con la tarifa KeyBid Puls de un estudio); no se admiten anuncios de alquiler, terrenos ni locales comerciales. Si el anuncio no se puede leer automáticamente, puedes enviar una captura o escribir los datos; KeyBid rechaza los valores no plausibles. El resultado aparece en una tarjeta con la foto del anuncio, los datos principales, la rentabilidad bruta con la neta debajo y el enlace al anuncio. La respuesta termina con un enlace que abre el mismo análisis en la web de KeyBid Genius (keybid.ro / keybid.eu), donde se puede comprar el informe PDF detallado de KeyBid para el anuncio. Los indicadores por ciudad y la sugerencia de tarifa por noche se basan en las medias de todos los alquileres vacacionales de la ciudad en los últimos 12 meses, solo para las ciudades en las que KeyBid tiene datos de mercado; para una vivienda concreta son estimaciones, no una garantía. Los resultados son estimaciones, no asesoramiento financiero ni una tasación oficial.
